evaluation_basis: Assessed for simulated execution, persistence, idempotency and risk controls—not for strategy profitability.
original_objective: Operate the unvalidated ICHIMOKU_SHADOW_V14 hypothesis prospectively on public CoinEx BTC/ETH 4h data with PostgreSQL-backed simulated PAPER execution.

engineering_result.summary: Risk gates, cost/depth-aware partial fills, deterministic client IDs, duplicate-bar protection, persistent positions/fills/equity and restart behavior were deployed and smoke-verified.

scientific_result.summary: The shadow strategy remained explicitly unvalidated and was not a promoted alpha model.

economic_result.summary: The subsequent production smoke showed two observations and one simulated fill—operational evidence only.

limitations: Simulated fills rather than exchange orders
Historical operational state differs from current PAPER_OFF state
contribution_to_next_version: Supplied the persistent PAPER runtime consumed by v0.15 immutable evidence snapshots.
